sentences.en: When they were teenagers, Ryan Brown and four of his friends decided to visit a really old graveyard.
sentences.zh: 在他们还是青少年时，瑞安·布朗和他的四个朋友决定去一个非常古老的墓地参观。

sentences.en: It was midnight, and they all piled onto an ATV belonging to his friend David.
sentences.zh: 当时是午夜，他们全都挤上了他朋友大卫的一辆全地形车。

sentences.en: And this ATV is really just made for one person.
sentences.zh: 而这辆全地形车其实只适合一个人坐。

sentences.en: So it's a vehicle with one big wheel in the front, two big wheels in the back, and David was driving.
sentences.zh: 所以它是一辆前边有一个大轮子、后边有两个大轮子的车，当时是大卫在开车。

sentences.en: The rest of us were all kind of piled onto the back, sitting on top of the wheel guards.
sentences.zh: 我们其余的人都挤在后面，坐在轮子挡泥板的顶上。

sentences.en: They took off down a dark country road.
sentences.zh: 他们顺着一条黑暗的乡间小路出发了。

sentences.en: He's going about as fast as he possibly can, and nobody's wearing a helmet, so if we crash, we're all dead.
sentences.zh: 他开得尽可能快，而且谁都没戴头盔，所以如果我们出车祸，我们都会死。

sentences.en: Fearing for his life, Ryan spoke up.
sentences.zh: 瑞安感到生命受到威胁，于是开了口。

sentences.en: And I said to David, over the road noise, the engine noise, it would really be nice if you'd slow down a bit.
sentences.zh: 我对大卫说，盖过路面噪音和发动机噪音，如果你能稍微开慢一点，那就真的太好了。

sentences.en: And he decided that was actually a great opportunity to turn off the headlights.
sentences.zh: 而他认为这其实是一个关掉前大灯的好机会。

sentences.en: So we're on this dark country road, no lighting, no seatbelts, no helmets.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这条黑暗的乡间公路上，没有照明，没有安全带，没有头盔。

sentences.en: I'm thinking, he's going to kill us, on the way to a graveyard, no less.
sentences.zh: 我在想，他这是要害死我们，而且还是在去墓地的路上。

sentences.en: So I start yelling at him, telling him he needs to slow down, he needs to turn the lights back on.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始对大卫大喊大叫，告诉他他需要慢点开，他需要把车灯重新打开。

sentences.en: And he is having none of it.
He feels threatened, he feels challenged.
sentences.zh: 他感到受到威胁，感到受到挑衅。

sentences.en: So by the time we get to the graveyard, I'm livid.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们到达墓地时，我已经气炸了。

sentences.en: I've been yelling at him for the past mile to slow down and turn on the lights.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一英里里，我一直在冲他大喊，让他减速并开灯。

sentences.en: And really, after that weekend, we never really spoke much again.
sentences.zh: 说实话，经历那个周末之后，我们基本上就再没怎么说过话了。

sentences.en: He was not able to apologize for his behavior.
sentences.zh: 他无法为自己的行为道歉。

sentences.en: I sort of apologized for mine, but I really wasn't all that sorry.
sentences.zh: 我算是为我的行为道了歉，但我其实并没有感到多么抱歉。

sentences.en: I felt like he'd taken my life and my friends' lives into his hands and treated them callously and thoughtlessly and recklessly.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他把我和朋友们的生命当儿戏，冷酷、轻率而又鲁莽地对待它们。

sentences.en: That story has stuck with Ryan, who went on to become a psychologist at Rice University in Texas.
sentences.zh: 这个故事一直留在瑞安的记忆里，他后来成为了德克萨斯州莱斯大学的一名心理学家。

sentences.en: He now understands why his friend refused to back down.
sentences.zh: 他现在明白了为什么他的朋友当时拒绝退让。

sentences.en: Today we examine how our society gives us stories.
sentences.zh: 今天我们探讨社会如何赋予我们故事。

sentences.en: Stories that dictate what we can and cannot do.
sentences.zh: 这些故事决定了我们能做什么和不能做什么。

sentences.en: How cultural scripts shape our lives.
sentences.zh: 文化脚本如何塑造我们的生活。

sentences.en: Years later, and thousands of miles from the scene of that midnight ride in the ATV,
sentences.zh: 多年以后，在距离那次午夜全地形车骑行数千英里之外的地方，

sentences.en: France and Italy are battling it out in the finals of the World Cup Soccer Championship.
sentences.zh: 法国队和意大利队正在世界杯足球锦标赛的决赛中展开对决。

sentences.en: More than 700 million people across the globe are watching.
sentences.zh: 全球有超过7亿人正在观看。

sentences.en: There are some real star performers out there, and two in particular, Zinedine Zidane, of course.
sentences.zh: 场上有一些真正的明星球员，其中特别有两位，当然就是齐内丁·齐达内。

sentences.en: Have we got a man here then?
sentences.zh: 那我们这儿是不是出了个人物？
接着，意大利队扳回一球。

sentences.en: With just a few minutes left of the game, something astonishing happens.
sentences.zh: 就在比赛只剩最后几分钟时，惊人的一幕发生了。

sentences.en: France's captain and star player, Zinedine Zidane, violently knocks the Italian player Marco Matarazzi to the ground.
sentences.zh: 法国队队长兼明星球员齐内丁·齐达内暴力地将意大利球员马尔科·马特拉齐撞倒在地。

sentences.en: Well, he's just headed Matarazzi in the middle of the cheSt.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他刚刚用头撞了马特拉齐的胸口中央。
这是一个明目张胆的犯规。

sentences.en: Zidane is ejected from the game.
Without its captain and star, France goes on to lose the match and lose the championship.
sentences.zh: 在缺少队长和球星的情况下，法国队最终输掉了比赛，也输掉了冠军。

sentences.en: And the showpiece of the world game has an unsavory moment here.
sentences.zh: 世界足球盛会的这场压轴戏出现了一个不光彩的时刻。

sentences.en: It will make the headlines beyond the results, I feel.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这会成为比赛结果之外的头条新闻。

sentences.en: It did make headlines around the world.
sentences.zh: 它确实成了世界各地的头条新闻。
每个人都有同一个疑问。

sentences.en: Why would someone, on the cusp of the greatest victory in his life, throw it all away?
sentences.zh: 为什么有人会在他人生的最伟大胜利即将来临时，把这一切都抛弃？

sentences.en: This was Zidane's final game of his career.
sentences.zh: 这是齐达内职业生涯的最后一场比赛。

sentences.en: He was the captain of the team, as you mentioned, representing France, although he was actually from Algeria.
sentences.zh: 正如你所提到的，他是球队队长，代表法国队，尽管他实际上来自阿尔及利亚。

sentences.en: This again is Rice University psychologist Ryan Brown.
sentences.zh: 这位再次出场的是莱斯大学心理学家瑞安·布朗。

sentences.en: Throughout the match, he was kind of sparring with Marco Matarazzi from Italy.
sentences.zh: 整场比赛中，他一直在与来自意大利的马尔科·马特拉齐针锋相对。

sentences.en: You could tell that they were being a little physical with each other.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出他们之间有些身体接触。
他们在整场比赛中一直在言语交锋。

sentences.en: And at one point, Matarazzi says something to him.
sentences.zh: 而在某个时刻，马特拉齐对他说了一些话。

sentences.en: Nobody can tell, of course, watching what was said.
sentences.zh: 当然，观看比赛的人谁也不知道说了什么。

sentences.en: But Zidane headbutts him in the cheSt.
sentences.zh: 但齐达内用头撞了他的胸口。

sentences.en: Now, nobody knew what had sparked this until a while later when Zidane was interviewed about it.
sentences.zh: 直到后来齐达内接受相关采访时，大家才知道是什么引发了这一切。

sentences.en: And it turns out that Matarazzi had insulted his sister.
sentences.zh: 原来是马特拉齐侮辱了他的姐姐。

sentences.en: Zidane had said, after the game, I'll give you my jersey as a souvenir.
sentences.zh: 齐达内在赛后曾说，我会把我的球衣送给你作为纪念。

sentences.en: Matarazzi replied that he'd rather have Zidane's sister.
sentences.zh: 马特拉齐回答说，他更想要齐达内的姐姐。

sentences.en: Clearly a suggestion of a sexual nature, and Zidane couldn't handle it.
sentences.zh: 这显然带有性暗示，齐达内无法忍受这一点。

sentences.en: About four years after this event, he was asked if he felt like he should apologize to Matarazzi.
sentences.zh: 大约在这件事发生四年后，有人问他是否觉得应该向马特拉齐道歉。

sentences.en: And he said he'd rather die than apologize.
sentences.zh: 他说他宁愿死也不道歉。

sentences.en: The French president, Jacques Chirac, weighed in on the incident.
sentences.zh: 法国总统雅克·希拉克也对这起事件发表了看法。

sentences.en: Far from bemoaning the loss of the world championship,
sentences.zh: 他非但没有哀叹世界杯冠军的失之交臂，

sentences.en: he hailed Zidane as a man of heart and conviction.
sentences.zh: 反而赞扬齐达内是一个有情有义、有坚定信念的男人。

sentences.en: Ryan Brown thinks there's a connection between what happened on that soccer field
sentences.zh: 瑞安·布朗认为，那个足球场上发生的事

sentences.en: and what happened to him and his friends when they were teenagers.
sentences.zh: 与他和朋友在青少年时期遭遇的事之间存在某种联系。

sentences.en: Even with the World Cup on the line, Zinedine Zidane would not back down
sentences.zh: 即使世界杯冠军悬于一线，齐内丁·齐达内也绝不退让，

sentences.en: when he felt his family was insulted.
sentences.zh: 当他觉得自己的家人受到侮辱时。

sentences.en: David would not back down, even as he was risking his life and the lives of his friends.
sentences.zh: 大卫也绝不退让，哪怕他正在拿自己和朋友们的生命去冒险。

sentences.en: Both the soccer player and the teenager were following the gendered scripts
sentences.zh: 这位足球运动员和这位少年都在遵循着带有性别色彩的脚本，

sentences.en: of what Ryan calls an honor culture.
sentences.zh: 瑞安将这种脚本称为荣誉文化。

sentences.en: Honor cultures are societies that put the defensive reputation at the center of social life
sentences.zh: 荣誉文化是指将维护名誉置于社会生活核心的社会，

sentences.en: and make that defense one of the highest priorities that people have.
sentences.zh: 并将这种维护作为人们拥有的最高优先级之一。

sentences.en: So in each one of these cases, there was an element of defensive reputation driving people's behaviors.
sentences.zh: 所以在这些案例中，都有防御名誉这一因素在驱动人们的行为。

sentences.en: In the case of Zidane, his sister's virtue had been called into question by an opponent
sentences.zh: 就齐达内而言，他姐姐的贞洁受到了对手的性质疑，

sentences.en: and he felt he absolutely had to respond.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己绝对必须作出回应。

sentences.en: He had no choice but to respond with aggression.
sentences.zh: 他别无选择，只能以攻击性来回应。

sentences.en: In the case of my friend David, driving late at night,
sentences.zh: 就我的朋友大卫而言，在深夜开车时，

sentences.en: that sort of behavior, excessive risk-taking behavior to show how brave and tough you are
sentences.zh: 那种行为——通过过度冒险来展示你有多勇敢、多顽强——

sentences.en: is an element of honor culture.
sentences.zh: 是荣誉文化的一个组成部分。

sentences.en: It's a way of building your reputation.
sentences.zh: 这是建立你名誉的一种方式。

sentences.en: And furthermore, his inability to back down when confronted by me
sentences.zh: 此外，当面对我的质问时，他无法退让，

sentences.en: was another aspect of honor culture that's very typical of people
sentences.zh: 则是荣誉文化的另一个方面，这在那些

sentences.en: who are driven by honor-related beliefs and values.
sentences.zh: 受荣誉相关信念和价值观驱使的人身上非常典型。

sentences.en: But all of us care about reputation.
sentences.zh: 但我们所有人都很在意名誉。

sentences.en: What's different about reputation in one of these honor cultures?
sentences.zh: 这些荣誉文化中的名誉有什么不同之处呢？

sentences.en: Every human being that's ever lived cares about their reputation.
sentences.zh: 古往今来，每一个人都在乎自己的名誉。

sentences.en: They care about how other people see them.
sentences.zh: 他们在乎别人如何看待自己。

sentences.en: Honor cultures put this normal, universal human concern on cultural steroids.
sentences.zh: 荣誉文化给这种人类正常且普遍的关切注入了文化强心剂。

sentences.en: And they also create a set of scripts or demands for how you should respond
sentences.zh: 它们还创造了一套脚本或要求，规定你应当如何反应

sentences.en: when your reputation is at risk.
sentences.zh: 当你的名誉处于危险之中时。

sentences.en: When your honor has been threatened, you have to respond in kind.
sentences.zh: 当你的荣誉受到威胁时，你必须以牙还牙地作出回应。

sentences.en: If you ever back down, you'll be known as the kind of person
sentences.zh: 如果你一旦退让，你就会被称为那种

sentences.en: who can be taken advantage of, who can be teased, who can be humiliated.
sentences.zh: 可以被占便宜、可以被取笑、可以被羞辱的人。

sentences.en: And you can't have that in an honor culture.
sentences.zh: 在荣誉文化中，这是绝对不被允许的。

sentences.en: You say that honor cultures are more likely to thrive in communities that are small or rural.
sentences.zh: 你说荣誉文化更有可能在规模较小或偏远的社区中繁荣。

sentences.en: In a small town, as you say, everyone knows your name and everyone knows your shame.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，在一个小镇里，每个人都知道你的名字，每个人也都知道你的丑事。

sentences.en: So smaller communities seem like, on the face of it,
sentences.zh: 所以从表面上看，较小的社区似乎

sentences.en: they should be safer communities because everybody knows everybody.
sentences.zh: 应该更安全，因为每个人都认识每个人。

sentences.en: And there are ways in which that might be true.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面这可能是真的。

sentences.en: But if that smaller community exists within an honor culture,
sentences.zh: 但如果那个较小的社区存在于一种荣誉文化之中，

sentences.en: then the fact that everybody knows who you are can be problematic for you,
sentences.zh: 那么每个人都知道你是谁这一点，反而会给你带来麻烦，

sentences.en: at least in the case when your honor has been threatened,
sentences.zh: 至少在你的荣誉受到威胁的时候，

sentences.en: when you have been humiliated, when you have failed in some public way,
sentences.zh: 当你受到羞辱时，当你以某种公开的方式失败时，
并且所有人都知道了这件事。

sentences.en: So you're the opposite of safe.
In a larger community, in a big city,
sentences.zh: 在一个较大的社区、一个大城市里，

sentences.en: you might have the same failure experience,
sentences.zh: 你可能会经历同样的失败，

sentences.en: but you can walk down the street and be relatively anonymous.
sentences.zh: 但你可以走在街上，保持相对的匿名。

sentences.en: That's not true in a small town.
If those smaller communities are situated within honor cultures.
sentences.zh: 如果这些较小的社区身处荣誉文化之中的话。

sentences.en: Are you yourself a product of an honor culture, Ryan?
sentences.zh: 瑞安，你自己也是荣誉文化的产物吗？

sentences.en: And I knew that when I began this research on honor cultures,
sentences.zh: 当我开始这项关于荣誉文化的调研时我就知道这一点，

sentences.en: but I didn't actually realize the extent to which it was true.
sentences.zh: 但我其实并没有意识到它对我的影响有多深。

sentences.en: In the United States, at least,
a lot of the roots of our honor-related beliefs and values
sentences.zh: 我们许多与荣誉相关的信念和价值观的根源

sentences.en: come to us from immigrants from Southern Scotland,
sentences.zh: 来自苏格兰南部的移民，

sentences.en: people who were broadly known as the Scots-Irish or Scotch-Irish.
sentences.zh: 也就是被广泛称为苏格兰-爱尔兰人或苏格兰爱尔兰人的人群。

sentences.en: And so it turns out my own people,
sentences.zh: 所以事实证明我自己的族群，

sentences.en: my own forebearers on my father's side,
Largely because of where they settled in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 很大程度上由于他们在美国定居的地点，

sentences.en: we can see the residue of these honor-related beliefs and values
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到这些荣誉相关的信念和价值观的残留，
也就是他们随身带来的那些，

sentences.en: in states primarily in the South and in the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 主要存在于南部和西部的州里。

sentences.en: In the North and Northern Midwest,
there were actually different groups of immigrants
sentences.zh: 其实有来自不同群体的移民

sentences.en: And all these different immigrant groups
sentences.zh: 所有这些不同的移民群体

sentences.en: brought their own beliefs and values with them.
sentences.zh: 都把他们自己的信念和价值观带了过来。

sentences.en: those beliefs and values remained intact within communities.
sentences.zh: 这些信念和价值观在各个社区中得以完好保存。

sentences.en: And so in communities in the Southern colonies,
sentences.zh: 因此，在南方殖民地的社区中，

sentences.en: was not quite the United States yet,
sentences.zh: 还算不上真正的美国时，

sentences.en: those beliefs and values of those Scottish immigrants
sentences.zh: 这些苏格兰移民的信仰和价值观

sentences.en: really came to dominate the cultures
sentences.zh: 真正主导了这些地方的文化，
并最终演变成南方各州。
是带着家人一起迁徙的，

sentences.en: which was unusual for transatlantic immigration at the time,
sentences.zh: 这在当时的跨大西洋移民中并不常见，

sentences.en: they were essentially able to outbreed
sentences.zh: 他们基本上能够压倒性地繁衍，

sentences.en: all these other groups that settled in the South.
sentences.zh: 超越所有其他定居南方的群体。

sentences.en: And so their norms and their values
that they brought over with them
sentences.zh: 那些行为准则和价值观

sentences.en: really came to dominate the communities,
sentences.zh: 真正开始主导各个社区，

sentences.en: the cultures of the Southern colonies,
And so if you think about Westerns,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你回想西部片，

sentences.en: if you think about Western movies or Western history,
sentences.zh: 如果你想到西部电影或西部历史，

sentences.en: there are always rough and tumble guys
with names that sound kind of Scottish,
sentences.zh: 他们的名字听起来有点像苏格兰人，

sentences.en: McTavish, McDonald, McDougal, Graham, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 比如麦克塔维什、麦克唐纳、麦克杜格尔、格雷姆等等。

sentences.en: So even today, even though most people in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 因此，即使在今天，尽管美国大多数人，

sentences.en: in the South don't think of themselves
sentences.zh: 尤其是南方人，并不认为自己

sentences.en: you can still see this cultural residue
sentences.zh: 你仍然可以在某些相当强烈的社会生活模式中

sentences.en: in some fairly powerful patterns of social life
that social scientists, many others, including myself,
sentences.zh: 社会科学家和包括我在内的许多其他人

sentences.en: have documented over the last 20 years.
sentences.zh: 在过去20里一直记录着这些现象。
你们确实发现了一种联系，

sentences.en: between honor culture and military valor.
sentences.zh: 即荣誉文化与军事英勇之间的联系。

sentences.en: Can you talk about that at a moment?
sentences.zh: 你能稍微谈谈这一点吗？

sentences.en: What is the relationship, for example,
sentences.zh: 例如，两者之间存在什么关系，

sentences.en: between the states that have a high honor culture
sentences.zh: 也就是荣誉文化盛行的州

sentences.en: and military success or military valor?
sentences.zh: 在军事成功或军事英勇方面有何不同？

sentences.en: my colleagues and I looked at the recipients
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事们研究了

sentences.en: of the Congressional Medal of Honor
sentences.zh: 国会荣誉勋章的获得者，

sentences.en: for soldiers that fought during World War II.
sentences.zh: 对象是二战期间参战的士兵。
所以我们检查了这些获奖者，

sentences.en: and what we found is that soldiers
who came from honor states in the U.S.,

sentences.zh: 获得国会荣誉勋章的概率

sentences.en: to have won the Congressional Medal of Honor
than soldiers who came from other states.
Valor can be exhibited by anyone.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可能表现出英勇。

sentences.en: it doesn't matter where you're from
But the important thing was that in this study,
sentences.zh: 但重要的一点是，在这项研究中，

sentences.en: that people who came from honor states
seem to be more likely to engage

sentences.zh: 那些会被认为具有英勇色彩的行为，
